name: Prevalence of undernourishment (% of population, 3-year average)
description: Share of population with habitual food consumption below dietary energy requirements (kcal). The canonical FAO food-insecurity headline indicator. Leading signal for famine, unrest, and forced displacement; broad country coverage and continuous series since 2000.

name: Prevalence of severe food insecurity (FIES, % of population)
description: Experience-based food insecurity measured via the Food Insecurity Experience Scale (FIES) module in household surveys. Captures acute household-level distress that kcal-based undernourishment misses; highly predictive of migration and civil unrest.

name: Number of people undernourished (millions, 3-year average)
description: Absolute count of undernourished people. Complements the prevalence rate by capturing demographic weight — a low-prevalence country with 200M people deserves attention that a high-prevalence small state does not.

name: Average dietary energy supply adequacy (%)
description: Dietary energy supply as a percentage of average dietary energy requirement. Adequacy below 100% means the national food supply cannot meet average caloric needs. Leading indicator for policy-driven food crises.

name: Food supply (kcal/capita/day)
description: Per capita daily food supply in kilocalories from the Food Balance Sheets. Direct caloric availability; moves slowly but significant drops are strong crisis signals.

name: Protein supply (g/capita/day)
description: Per capita daily protein supply in grams from the Food Balance Sheets. Protein adequacy is a stronger nutrition signal than calories alone and correlates with child stunting.

name: Cereals, total — Production (tonnes)
description: Total cereal production in tonnes (item code 1717 = Cereals aggregate, element 5510 = Production). Core food-security production metric; large year-over-year drops are leading drought/war indicators.

name: Cereals, total — Yield (hg/ha)
description: Total cereal yield in hectograms per hectare. Isolates productivity from area effects — sudden yield drops flag climate shocks even when area is stable. Inverse of agricultural vulnerability.

name: Wheat — Production (tonnes)
description: Wheat production in tonnes (item 15, element 5510). Global staple with heavy geopolitical weight (Russia/Ukraine/India exporters). Specific commodity exposure matters for trade-disruption analysis.

name: Rice, paddy — Production (tonnes)
description: Paddy rice production in tonnes. The staple for ~3.5B people; Asian food security is heavily rice-dependent and rice export bans are recurrent policy instruments during crises.

name: Cereals, total — Import quantity (tonnes)
description: Cereal imports in tonnes. Combined with domestic production, quantifies import dependency — the single strongest predictor of exposure to global food-price shocks (Arab Spring 2011 precedent).

name: Consumer Prices, Food Indices (2015=100)
description: Food price index relative to 2015 baseline. Food inflation is the classic unrest precursor — spikes above ~200 have historically preceded civil unrest episodes in lower-income states.

name: Agricultural land (1000 ha)
description: Total agricultural land area in thousand hectares (arable + permanent crops + pastures). Tracks land pressure; declining per-capita agricultural land is a slow-moving conflict driver in rural societies.

name: Arable land (1000 ha)
description: Arable land area in thousand hectares. Narrower than agricultural land — only land under temporary crops. The numerator for arable-land-per-capita carrying capacity calculations.

name: Nitrogen fertilizer use (tonnes of nutrient N)
description: Total nitrogen fertilizer use per country in tonnes of nutrient. Proxy for agricultural intensification and for exposure to fertilizer price/supply shocks (Russia/Belarus are dominant exporters).

name: Forest area (1000 ha)
description: Total forest area in thousand hectares. Deforestation is both a climate signal and a land-conflict signal (Amazon, Congo Basin). Long-running series with >200 country coverage.

name: Cattle stocks (head)
description: Total cattle population in head. Agricultural capital in pastoralist societies; large herd contractions are a leading indicator of drought-driven displacement in the Sahel and Horn of Africa.

name: Emissions from agriculture (CO2eq, Gg)
description: Total agricultural greenhouse gas emissions in gigagrams of CO2-equivalent. Agricultural decarbonization pressure is an emerging policy-risk dimension for agri-export economies.

name: Vegetable Oils — Food supply (kcal/capita/day)
description: Per capita daily caloric supply from vegetable oils. Oils are typically the second-largest kcal category after cereals in low-income diets; palm/soy oil supply shocks propagate fast into food inflation.

name: Fish and seafood — Production (tonnes)
description: Total fish and seafood production (capture + aquaculture). Protein security dimension missing from WB catalog; also a maritime-dispute and illegal-fishing signal relevant to EEZ tensions.
